meta.note: 周年祝福词库 v0.1：5对象 × 4风格 + 5里程碑年份 + work 职场
meta.quality: 手工打磨，温暖真诚，带具体感

romantic: Happy anniversary to my husband, my best friend, and my favorite person. Every year with you is my favorite year.
To the man who still gives me butterflies: happy anniversary. Loving you is the easiest and best thing I've ever done.
Another year of us, and I love you more today than I did on our wedding day. Happy anniversary, my love.
Thank you for choosing me every single day. Happy anniversary to the love of my life.
funny: Happy anniversary! Thanks for putting up with me for another year — I promise I'm still worth it. 😉
Happy anniversary to my favorite person to annoy for life. Love you anyway!
Another year married, and you still haven't run away. That's true love. Happy anniversary!
Happy anniversary! We've survived [X] years of my cooking and your snoring. Here's to forever!
short: Happy anniversary, my love. Here's to us.
Still crazy about you after all these years. Happy anniversary!
Happy anniversary to my favorite person in the world.
Every day with you is a gift. Happy anniversary!
religious: Happy anniversary, my love. Thank God every day for bringing you into my life. 'Two are better than one' (Ecclesiastes 4:9).
Celebrating another year of God's blessing on our marriage. Happy anniversary, my husband.
May God continue to bless our marriage as we celebrate another year together. Happy anniversary!

romantic: Happy anniversary to my beautiful wife. You are the best thing that ever happened to me, and I fall for you more every year.
To my wife, my partner, my home: happy anniversary. Loving you is the greatest privilege of my life.
Every love story is beautiful, but ours is my favorite. Happy anniversary, my darling wife.
Thank you for being my soft place to land. Happy anniversary to the woman who makes everything better.
funny: Happy anniversary to the woman who still laughs at my jokes. You're a keeper (and so am I, apparently).
Happy anniversary! You're still the best decision I ever made. My second-best decision was learning to say 'yes, dear.'
Another year of marriage and you still haven't filed for divorce. Winning! Happy anniversary!
Happy anniversary! Thanks for being my better half — literally, because I'm only half as good without you.
short: Happy anniversary to my amazing wife.
You're my everything. Happy anniversary, my love.
Happy anniversary to the woman who makes life beautiful.
Still the love of my life. Happy anniversary!
religious: Happy anniversary, my love. 'Love is patient, love is kind' (1 Corinthians 13:4) — and you are both. Thank God for you.
Celebrating the gift of our marriage. Happy anniversary to my wonderful wife. God blessed me with you.
May God continue to guide our marriage with love. Happy anniversary, my dear wife.

romantic: Happy anniversary to a couple whose love inspires everyone around them. Wishing you many more years of happiness.
May your love continue to grow deeper with every passing year. Happy anniversary to a beautiful couple!
Happy anniversary! Your love story is proof that true love exists. Wishing you a lifetime of joy.
Watching the two of you together is a reminder that love really does conquer all. Happy anniversary!
funny: Happy anniversary! May your love continue to grow, and may your arguments stay about whose turn it is to pick the movie.
Happy anniversary to the couple who proves that love is real — and that sharing a blanket is still a struggle.
Congrats on another year of marriage! You've officially survived [X] years of each other's quirks. Impressive!
Happy anniversary! Here's to love, laughter, and happily ever after (with occasional bickering over the thermostat).
short: Happy anniversary to a wonderful couple!
Wishing you both a happy anniversary filled with love.
Happy anniversary! May your love story never end.
Congratulations on another year of love. Happy anniversary!
religious: Happy anniversary! May God continue to bless your marriage with love, patience, and joy. 'What God has joined together' (Mark 10:9).
Celebrating the beautiful marriage God has blessed. Happy anniversary to a wonderful couple!
May your anniversary be filled with gratitude for the love God has given you. Blessings on your marriage!

romantic: Happy anniversary to the couple who taught me what love looks like. Your love is my favorite example of forever.
Thank you for showing us what a real marriage looks like. Happy anniversary, Mom and Dad!
Your love story built our family, and we're so grateful. Happy anniversary to the best parents in the world!
Every milestone you celebrate together is a gift to our family. Happy anniversary, Mom and Dad!
funny: Happy anniversary, Mom and Dad! Thanks for proving that love (and patience) can survive decades of parenting.
Congrats on another year of marriage! You two are the reason I believe in love — and in family game nights.
Happy anniversary to the original lovebirds! Thanks for setting the bar (and for all those years of embarrassing us lovingly).
Another year married, another year of Dad's jokes and Mom's eye rolls. Happy anniversary! True love indeed.
short: Happy anniversary to the best parents in the world!
Wishing you both a beautiful anniversary. We love you!
Happy anniversary, Mom and Dad! So grateful for your love.
Congrats on another year of love. Happy anniversary!
religious: Happy anniversary, Mom and Dad! Your marriage is a testimony of God's faithfulness. We're so blessed by your example.
Thank you for building our family on love and faith. Happy anniversary, and may God continue to bless your marriage.
Celebrating the godly marriage you've modeled for us. Happy anniversary, Mom and Dad!

romantic: Happy anniversary to two of my favorite people! Your love is beautiful to witness.
Wishing my favorite couple a happy anniversary! May your love keep growing stronger.
So happy to celebrate your anniversary! Your relationship is one of the best things in my life to watch.
funny: Happy anniversary, you two! Thanks for being the couple that gives the rest of us hope (and couple goals).
Congrats on another year of marriage! I've seen you fight over the remote, so I know this love is real.
Happy anniversary! May your love be as strong as your WiFi connection. (So, very strong.)
short: Happy anniversary to a wonderful couple!
Wishing you both a beautiful anniversary!
Happy anniversary! So happy for you two.
Congrats on another year of love!
religious: Happy anniversary! May God continue to bless your marriage richly. So happy to celebrate you both.
Celebrating God's goodness in your marriage. Happy anniversary, friends!
Wishing you a blessed anniversary. Your marriage is a testimony!

1st.label: 1st Anniversary Wishes
1st.note: Paper anniversary — the first year of marriage, full of new memories.

romantic: Happy 1st anniversary! The first year of forever, and it's been the best year of my life.
One year down, forever to go. Happy 1st anniversary, my love!
Happy anniversary! Year one was beautiful — I can't wait for all the years ahead.
Our first year of marriage was everything I dreamed and more. Happy 1st anniversary!
funny: Happy 1st anniversary! We survived year one — the hardest part is over (or so they say).
One year married! You've officially seen me at my best and my most annoying. And you stayed. Happy anniversary!
Happy 1st anniversary! Year one complete, and you still haven't run for the hills. Impressive.
short: Happy 1st anniversary! Here's to forever.
One year of us. Happy anniversary, my love!
Happy 1st anniversary to my favorite person!
Year one was amazing. Happy anniversary!
religious: Happy 1st anniversary! Thank God for our first year of marriage. 'What God has joined together' — and what a year it's been.
Celebrating one year of God's blessing on our marriage. Happy anniversary, my love!

25th.label: 25th Anniversary Wishes (Silver)
25th.note: Silver anniversary — 25 years of marriage, a true milestone.

romantic: Happy 25th anniversary! A quarter century of love, and you still make my heart skip a beat.
Twenty-five years ago we said 'I do,' and I'd say it again a thousand times. Happy silver anniversary, my love.
Happy 25th anniversary! Our love has stood the test of time — and it's only getting stronger.
A quarter of a century with you, and I love you more every single day. Happy silver anniversary!
funny: Happy 25th anniversary! 25 years, 25 years of you stealing the covers. Worth it.
Congrats on 25 years! That's 9,125 days of marriage — and you've made it look easy (mostly).
Happy silver anniversary! 25 years of love, laughter, and 'what did you say?' — here's to 25 more!
short: Happy 25th anniversary! What a milestone.
25 years of love. Happy silver anniversary!
Congratulations on 25 beautiful years together!
Happy anniversary! A quarter century of love.
religious: Happy 25th anniversary! A quarter century of God's faithfulness to your marriage. What a blessing!
Celebrating 25 years of marriage — a testimony of love and faith. Happy silver anniversary!
Thank God for 25 years of your marriage. May He bless you with 25 more. Happy anniversary!

50th.label: 50th Anniversary Wishes (Golden)
50th.note: Golden anniversary — 50 years of marriage, a rare and precious milestone.

romantic: Happy 50th anniversary! Half a century of love, and your story is more beautiful than any fairy tale.
Fifty years ago you promised forever — and you meant it. Happy golden anniversary, my love.
Happy 50th anniversary! Your love has been the gold standard for everyone who knows you.
A lifetime of love, laughter, and memories. Happy 50th anniversary to the couple who defines forever!
funny: Happy 50th anniversary! 50 years — you've officially made it longer than most appliances and just as reliable. 😉
Congrats on 50 years! That's half a century of 'I love you' and 'did you take out the trash?' Beautifully done.
Happy golden anniversary! 50 years of marriage — you two are the real gold.
short: Happy 50th anniversary! A golden milestone.
50 years of love. Happy golden anniversary!
Congratulations on 50 beautiful years together!
Happy anniversary! Half a century of love.
religious: Happy 50th anniversary! Half a century of God's faithfulness to your marriage. Truly a golden blessing!
Celebrating 50 years of marriage — a shining testimony of love and faith. Happy golden anniversary!
Thank God for 50 years of your marriage. May your golden anniversary be filled with joy and gratitude.

work.label: Work Anniversary Wishes
work.note: Work anniversaries celebrate professional milestones — a different kind of anniversary with its own etiquette.

romantic: Happy work anniversary! Your dedication and passion inspire everyone on the team.
Congratulations on another year of excellence! Your contributions have made a real difference.
Happy work anniversary! Thank you for your commitment and the positive energy you bring every day.
funny: Happy work anniversary! Thanks for showing up, showing out, and not showing up late too often.
Congrats on another year at the office! We'd be lost without you (literally — the printer confuses us).
Happy work anniversary! Another year of making it look easy. Your coffee skills and teamwork are unmatched.
short: Happy work anniversary! We're lucky to have you.
Congrats on another great year! Happy anniversary.
Happy work anniversary! Here's to many more.
Happy anniversary at work — you're appreciated!
religious: Happy work anniversary! May God continue to bless your work and your calling.
Congrats on your work anniversary! 'Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart' (Colossians 3:23). You embody this.

5th.label: 5th Anniversary Wishes
5th.note: Five years of marriage — the foundation is built, the adventure continues.

romantic: Happy 5th anniversary! Five years of building a life together, and I'd choose you again every single time.
Five years ago we started this adventure, and every year with you gets better. Happy 5th anniversary, my love!
Happy 5th anniversary! We've built a foundation of love that can weather anything. Here's to forever.
Five years of us, and my love for you has only grown. Happy anniversary to my favorite person.
funny: Happy 5th anniversary! Five years in, and you still haven't figured out my mood swings. Lucky for you, I love you anyway!
Congrats on 5 years! That's 1,825 days of putting up with each other. We should get medals. Happy anniversary!
Happy 5th anniversary! We've survived 5 years of marriage, which means we're officially qualified to give advice. (We won't, though.)
short: Happy 5th anniversary! Here's to us.
Five years of love. Happy anniversary!
Happy 5th anniversary to my favorite person!
Five years down, forever to go!
religious: Happy 5th anniversary! Thank God for five years of marriage. 'Love never fails' (1 Corinthians 13:8).
Celebrating five years of God's blessing on our marriage. Happy anniversary, my love!
May God continue to guide our love story. Happy 5th anniversary!

10th.label: 10th Anniversary Wishes
10th.note: Ten years of marriage — a decade of love, growth, and shared history. Traditional gift: tin or aluminum.

romantic: Happy 10th anniversary! A decade of love, laughter, and growing together. I love you more every single day.
Ten years ago we said forever — and we meant it. Happy 10th anniversary, my love!
Happy 10th anniversary! A decade of building our life together, and the best is yet to come.
Ten years with you, and I'd do it all again in a heartbeat. Happy anniversary to my everything.
funny: Happy 10th anniversary! A decade of marriage — we've officially lasted longer than most celebrity marriages. Go us!
Congrats on 10 years! That's a decade of 'what do you want for dinner?' and 'I don't know, what do YOU want?' True love.
Happy 10th anniversary! Ten years in, and we still like each other. That's practically a miracle. Love you!
short: Happy 10th anniversary! A decade of us.
Ten years of love. Happy anniversary!
Happy 10th anniversary to my forever person!
A decade together. Happy anniversary!
religious: Happy 10th anniversary! A decade of God's faithfulness to our marriage. What a blessing!
Celebrating ten years of marriage — a testament to love and faith. Happy anniversary, my love!
Thank God for ten years of our love story. May He bless us with many more. Happy anniversary!
